in_marathi.name: Jeevika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Life
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jeevika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jeevika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jeev' meaning 'life'. The suffix 'ka' denotes the feminine gender. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of life is often personified as Aditi, the mother of all gods. Thus, Jeevika is a name that symbolizes the nurturing and sustaining power of life.
